a964cc.title: Backend AuthZ agent — validated findings summary
a964cc.content:
Backend deep-dive complete. Validated (vitest PoCs passing, synthetic mocks only):
1. Cross-org IDOR on knowledge-base + briefing routes (kb-idor.poc.test.ts) — service layer has no org filter anywhere.
2. Default JWT secret forgery + ?token= query auth + cognito internal-token HMAC key = public userPoolId (auth-forgery.poc.test.ts).
3. Unauthenticated avatar generate endpoints (avatar-routes.authz.poc.test.ts).
4. Public webhook trigger, no signature/replay protection (webhook-trigger-authz.poc.test.ts).
5. IM webhook processed with no auth header, runs agent in victim org (im-webhook-auth.poc.test.ts).
6. pack-deploy path traversal reads files outside industry-packs (pack-deploy-traversal.poc.test.ts).
7. agentAccess cross-org permission confusion (tenant-isolation.audit.test.ts).
8. WebSocket /ws/executions unauthenticated, no origin/tenant checks, arbitrary executionId subscription.
9. Chat sessions org-scoped but not user-scoped (horizontal IDOR within org).
10. S3 workspace fallback key traversal (unvalidated filePath in key).
11. KB listFiles user-controlled Prisma orderBy key; scopePlugins/MCP list GETs unscoped.
Ruled out: SQLi (all raw calls parameterized; appData sanitizeKey), files.routes org prefix check, workflows/documents org scoping, appData/appBackend/showcase, widget/apiKey auth, organizations role management.
Open: SSRF surfaces (action-executor, MCP health-check, skill marketplace) — no allowlists, but authenticated-authorship required; KB orderBy Prisma behavior unverified at runtime.

4bac27.title: Triage: TOP ranked candidates (root: spawn validation agents)
4bac27.content:
Ranked candidates from baseline triage of super-agent (opengrep/trivy/gitleaks/trufflehog/ast-grep). Artifacts in /workspace/.source-aware/.

## P1 — likely real, highest priority
1. **Backend RCE via eval() in workflow transform nodes** — `backend/src/services/node-executors/action-executor.ts:280,306,325` (also `condition-executor.ts:230`, `code-artifact-executor.ts:296`). `applyFilter`/`applyReduce`/`applyCustomTransform` `eval()` a `transformConfig.expression` that comes from workflow node metadata (user-authored workflow JSON). If any authenticated tenant user can save/execute a workflow with a transform node, this is **authenticated RCE** on the backend (Node `eval` = full server-side code execution). Validation needed: trace workflow save→execute route, check who can author workflows, whether expression is sanitized anywhere upstream. This is the single highest-value candidate.

2. **Frontend XSS surface — token in iframe URL query param** — `frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx:612` (`PublishedAppPreviewTab`): `fullUrl = ${baseUrl}${url}?...token=${localStorage.getItem('local_auth_token') || 'cognito_id_token'}`. JWT put in a URL query string — leaks via Referer headers, browser history, server logs. Combined with `sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin ..."` on generated/app-preview iframes (Chat.tsx:600, AppRunner.tsx:160): `allow-scripts + allow-same-origin` on same-origin content = sandbox is a **no-op** — agent-generated app content runs with full origin privileges and can read `localStorage` (the auth tokens). That's a **stored XSS → token theft** chain if agent output controls the previewed app.

3. **highlight.js `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`** — `frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx:470` renders `hljs.highlight(code).value`. hljs escapes HTML entities by default but has known bypasses (CVE-2024-41015-ish class, backtick/attribute edge cases). Medium; needs a validated payload.

4. **`xlsx` 0.18.5 in frontend (SheetJS CDN fork)** — `frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx:179` imports it to parse agent workspace spreadsheets. CVE-2023-30533 (prototype pollution → RCE when parsing untrusted files) + CVE-2024-22363 (ReDoS). Reachable: file content is agent/user-generated. Known-CVE finding candidate (needs reachability writeup).

## P2 — needs reachability analysis
5. **Known-CVE dependencies, backend/package-lock.json (89 crit/high)**: axios 1.13.6 (CVE-2026-42043 CVSS 10 etc.), hono 4.10.6, lodash 4.17.21 (CVE-2026-4800 9.8), protobufjs 7.5.4 (9.8), undici 6.24.1 (9.1), fastify 5.6.2 (8.1), @fastify/busboy, @fastify/static. Also `agentcore/package-lock.json`: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0 (multiple 7.5), ip-address 10.2.0 (8.6); `app-hosting/poc` fastify 4.29.1 (8.1) + find-my-way (7.5); `frontend`: react-router 7.12.0 (8.1, 3 CVEs), ws 8.19.0; `infra`: aws-cdk-lib 2.246.0. Full list: parse /workspace/.source-aware/trivy-fs.json. Version alone ≠ reachability — needs per-CVE usage analysis before reporting as dependency findings.

## P3 — reviewed, looked weak/clean
- **Raw SQL**: all `prisma.$queryRawUnsafe` uses (vector-memory, rag-retriever, support-*, knowledge-base) are **parameterized** ($1/$2). `appData.routes.ts` builds dynamic SQL but `sanitizeKey()` strips everything outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_]` (appData.routes.ts:261) — key names neutralized; values are bound params. No SQLi found so far.
- **Path traversal**: `workspace-manager.ts:1547` `resolveWorkspaceFilePath` uses `join` + `startsWith(workspacePath)` — classic prefix check; `workspacePath` lacks trailing separator but `resolved.startsWith(workspacePath)` with join is probably OK... validation agent should test `filePath='../workspacePathX/...'` sibling-prefix edge case (low-medium).
- **Secrets (gitleaks+trufflehog, 39+1)**: all PoC/local docker-compose credentials (app-hosting/poc: `alpha_pg_poc_123`, `apphost123`, k8s tenant yamls, seed.ts) and example.com/MDN doc URLs. `backend/.env` is git-ignored (local dev only, placeholder-looking). The one gitleaks hit: `industry-packs/industry-pack-voice/.../multi-factor-verification/SKILL.md:101` `VT-MFA-20240315-uuid` — likely placeholder in marketing content. **No real production secrets found** — treat as hygiene, not findings.
- **Install scripts**: no malicious `preinstall`/`postinstall` in any package.json scripts. Dockerfiles: backend multi-stage + non-root (good); agentcore installs `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` globally + `uv` and runs agent-authored code by design (intended).
- **agentcore execSync git**: fixed strings only (`agent-runner.ts:123-241`), no injection.
- **Outbound fetch surface**: `skill-marketplace.service.ts` has ~10 `fetch(rawUrl)` calls with user-influenced URLs → SSRF candidate for a dedicated validation agent (marketplace install flow).
